assumptions: See assumptions A-CONTROLS-001 and A-HERITAGE-001.
building_height_max_m.reason: Height control values are not published, and the submission rule for this package forbids stating building heights; the bell frame height is expressed only as an intent not to rise above the mature street-tree canopy.

constraint_feature_count.formula: count(constraints.features) once official constraint geometry is supplied
assumptions: Heritage protection ranges, road redlines, ownership boundaries and utility corridors are all still missing.
See assumptions A-CONTROLS-001 and A-RECALC-001.
constraint_feature_count.reason: constraints.geojson is an empty FeatureCollection carrying a declared data gap. Zero features means the official constraint geometry has not been published, not that the site has no constraints; reporting 0 as a finding would be a false negative.

heritage_protection_area_sqm.formula: area(project(heritage protection range and construction control zone polygons))
assumptions: Until the boundary is obtained the package uses a substitute rule (nothing enters the north-west quadrant of the bell plaza).
See assumptions A-HERITAGE-001.
heritage_protection_area_sqm.reason: The protection range and construction control zone of the Tsinghua Yuan station are published as a text notice; the GIS boundary has not been released, so no polygon can be measured.

resident_population_count.formula: sum(resident population of the sub-districts intersecting the site boundary)
assumptions: This is why the per-capita metrics use a reported served population instead, and are labelled indicative.
See assumptions A-POP-001.
resident_population_count.reason: Per-sub-district resident population along the corridor is not published: the seventh census release only bands sub-districts by size, so the population inside the submitted boundary cannot be derived.

assumptions: The answer-gate mechanism scales to whatever number is actually built.

park_entrance_built_count.reason: 46 entrances is the phase-2 planning figure; the as-built number and positions are not itemised in the opening coverage, so the built count is unverified.

road_redline_width_m.formula: width(official road redline) once the statutory plan attachments are published
assumptions: All road geometry in this package is tagged concept=true.
See assumptions A-CONTROLS-001.
road_redline_width_m.reason: Road redlines are not published and this package draws concept centrelines only; stating a redline width would be a statutory conclusion it is not entitled to make.

pilot_zone_area_sqm.formula: area(project(pilot zone boundaries)) once the boundaries are published
assumptions: See assumptions A-PILOT-001.
pilot_zone_area_sqm.reason: The Dazhongsi and Wudaokou pilot zones are named in public releases but their boundaries and areas have never been published, so no polygon and no area can be produced.

investment_estimate_cny.formula: sum(quantity * unit_price) over the declared quantity base
assumptions: Registering one public cost-index source would let the existing quantity base be developed straight into an itemised estimate.
investment_estimate_cny.reason: The quantity base is complete, but no public construction cost index is registered in sources.json, so no unit price and no amount can be stated.
